method: Direct view_image review of unedited UE captures; original header pixel audit verifies selection brightness and detects the old defect. Alpha review covers all 14 native journal PNGs.
observations: All six selected symbols have a clear warm-white gold highlight and a soft halo; only the selected icon and underline are highlighted.
Actual PNG pixel audit passes a selected peak >= 215/255 and >= 90% of the main reference, with >= 20 bright pixels.
All five previously dim selected categories are clearly brighter; original icon silhouettes and positions remain.
Unknown rows and empty detail panes retain separators and remain blank.
The 150% text view remains readable without overlap.
